answer: A lotus bond stops fakes: each lotus locks 70 credits and files a sealed work commitment at tide-open, hashed to its own key. A random pulse summons it mid-tide: within one hour it must reveal that work, key-signed. Auditors replay hash, key and pulse time; a late reveal burns 20, a second burns all 70; a rented reveal fails its hash. Each fake locks 70 and pays 12 per tide, so 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 and pay 12,000; honest agents pay 12 once.
